slides.title: Principal AI Engineer assessment
slides.caption:
Native Rust implementation and measured local evidence.
This is a captioned walkthrough, not a screen recording.
The assessment remains INCOMPLETE.
No provider-trained student or quality improvement is claimed.
Reports and code are the reviewable evidence.

slides.title: Design: the ceiling drives the loop
slides.caption:
Tasks -> configurable fleet -> isolated grading -> curation
-> genuine LoRA -> held-out gate -> local serving.
A specialised student may beat an individual teacher on this
narrow workload by learning verified complementary outputs.
This does not establish general superiority over frontier
models.
An inconclusive gate means NO SHIP.

slides.title: Task supply and source separation
slides.caption:
The authored catalogue has 96 Rust coding contracts:
48 train, 16 development, 32 held out; 24 source groups.
Complete sources are assigned before model collection.
Lineage, executable oracles and provenance accompany tasks.
One author may induce dependence between source groups.
The sealed set must never become a tuning dashboard.

slides.title: Fleet and durable budget invariants
slides.caption:
Recorded local fault observations:
labelled_software_assurance_fixtures
Transactional reservations precede every attempted call.
Finished request keys are cached; unknown remote acceptance
retains its reservation.
Synthetic faults are labelled as fixtures.
Three independent real provider recordings are still required.
No missing completion is fabricated.

slides.title: Actual Qwen base and gradient QA
slides.caption:
Pinned real Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B-Instruct on CPU.
Base generated 29 output tokens; complete=true; 7244 ms.
Full-base synthetic tensor QA: 512 input tokens.
Loss 10.041237; gradient norm 7.327373.
Changed adapter L2 0.088431; safetensors round trip=true.
This is technical QA, not provider-output training.

slides.title: Actual bounded local endpoint
slides.caption:
Real model health includes checksum and inference checks.
Complete generated output: 29 tokens.
Oversized body HTTP 413; excessive tokens HTTP 400.
Concurrent pressure statuses: {"503":10,"504":2}.
Initialise -> explicit evaluation route -> atomic rollback.
The evaluation alias serves the same base weights.
No trained candidate canary is claimed.

slides.title: The gate: quality must be measured
slides.caption:
Actual evaluation status: INVALID_EVALUATION.
Ship requires both source-level interval lower bounds above the
predeclared +2 percentage-point margin.
All task and decoding-seed outcomes remain in the denominator.
Eight held-out sources give weak statistical power.
Negative/null score fixtures test the decision logic only.
Actual checkpoint controls remain a separate requirement.

slides.title: Honest remaining evidence
slides.caption:
Rights/model/account clearance and spending authority.
Real calls to three independent provider businesses.
Passing isolated grades and a validated provider dataset.
Actual candidate, second-seed and negative/overfit adapters.
Frozen held-out evaluation, measured costs and a real gate.
Full provider-trained disconnected rehearsal.
Local security passes do not replace these missing artifacts.

slides.title: Reproduce and review
slides.caption:
./run.sh demo --offline
The full command fails if required evidence is absent.
Inspect reports/drill.json and reports/eval.json.
Native QA examples: model_smoke, cpu_gradient_smoke,
serving_smoke.
Read docs/training.md and docs/reproduction.md.
The repository includes source, checksums, tests and explicit
limitations.
NO SHIP keeps the incumbent.

limitations: Captioned slides display actual report facts; this is not a claimed screen capture or narrated live demo.
Fixture QA, base inference and synthetic tensor updates are explicitly distinguished from actual provider-trained assessment evidence.
